caption: Same nine contact predictors and 314 natural proteins; Precision @ L/2 contacts, L=frozen input length. Every natural row uses the full floor(L/2) denominator. See PL2_ANALYSIS.md. Neff is recomputed on the exact frozen predictor alignments: sum of inverse neighbor counts at >=80% identity over jointly non-gap columns. Repeated sequences are downweighted; no alignment or prediction is changed. Bins are <10, 10–<100, 100–<1000 and >=1000. Means and 95% intervals bootstrap proteins; cohort membership changes relative to raw depth. Split, viral and design views remain separate. Every score, Neff measurement and contributing protein traces through neff_figure_rows.csv, neff_summary.csv and NEFF_ANALYSIS.md.
